observed_evidence: Across 65 held-out mornings, mean simulated abandonment was 17.23% with a fixed reserve and 18.48% under receding-horizon dispatch. Observed abandonment averaged 13.91%.
conditional_action: Review out-of-time discrepancies in waiting and abandonment before staffing a live shift. The forecast and flexibility costs can be varied independently.
claim_boundary: Historical outcomes describe observed calls. Staffing schedules, patience past the censoring point, operator flexibility and policy-dependent waits are simulated. The five-hour morning replay begins with an empty queue.
